# Patients under the water-peak rule {#sec-usable-patients}


Every patient in the main analysis with **both breasts usable** under the water-peak rule of @sec-the-rule, plotted the same way as the newest
patients (@sec-new-patients): one panel per patient, usable scans coloured (left blue, right orange), rejected scans grey and dashed, black bar
the water-peak threshold. No outcome tinting — every patient in the usable groups already has both breasts usable. Grouped by the label pair used
in the comparisons (109 patients), plus the NORMAL/NORMAL patients that missed the threshold entirely.
